study_design: Prospective nested case-control analysis within the Health Professionals Follow-up Study.
reason: The abstract evaluates subsequent incident prostate cancer overall. The description of most cases as organ confined and the statement about possible effects at later stages do not establish an analyzed aggressive incidence endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: For 25(OH)D the OR of prostate cancer comparing the top and bottom quartiles was 1.19 (95% CI: 0.79-1.79, p-trend = 0.59).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is explicitly for prostate cancer overall, with no aggressive endpoint specified.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
